nodes.speaker: King Aldric
nodes.text: Brave adventurers! Thornvale is in great peril. Dark creatures have been emerging from the cavern to the south. I need someone courageous to investigate.

choices.label: Tell us more about the threat.

nodes.speaker: King Aldric
nodes.text: For weeks, goblins and worse things have crawled out of the Dark Cavern. Our guards are overwhelmed. We've lost contact with the miners who worked the deep tunnels. Something sinister lurks below... I can feel it.

nodes.speaker: King Aldric
nodes.text: Excellent! Head south to the Dark Cavern entrance. Be careful down there - the caves twist and turn, and the creatures grow stronger the deeper you go. The Healer can tend to your wounds before you leave. May fortune favor you!

nodes.speaker: King Aldric
nodes.text: I understand. Take your time to prepare. Speak with the Healer and the Tavern Keeper - they may be able to help. Return to me when you're ready.
